items.title: Establishment variance: shell/site swing G1<->G2 across same-arm runs; ground/food are hard gaps
items.target_gap: establishment.score swings 2.0-3.0 across same-arm runs; G2 needs 2.5 (standard)
evidence: Cross-run (same arm, re-scored with fixed metric): -5 score=3.0 site=yes shell=yes (G2); -6 score=2.5 site=yes shell=yes (G2); -7 score=2.0 site=partial shell=NO (G1). Different emergent missions (t_f8d7b177/t_016c86a0/t_5d0bbe09).
SWING milestone = shell (walls+roof) + site completion: succeeds in -5/-6, fails in -7 -> NAV/place-on-village variance, NOT a hard ceiling. Matches [[project_genesis_v2_validated]] ceiling.
HARD gaps (never reached in any of -5/-6/-7): ground=level pad, food=farm. These are genuine missing capabilities, not variance.
Caveat: emergent missions differ per run, so establishment is NOT apples-to-apples across -5/-6/-7; compare_safe only gates operational safety, not mission equivalence.
items.candidate_direction: Two distinct sub-targets: (A) reduce shell/site place-on-village variance (reliability of existing capability); (B) author ground(level-pad)+food(farm) card templates (new capability). Village/nav-aware planner templates per memory 'Next'; motor changes deferred. Needs operator design choice on A-vs-B priority before implementation.
items.blocked_by: gv2-scope-coverage-metric validation (don't stack a behavioral change before the measurement fix is validated on a same-arm run — would muddy attribution).
items.notes: PROPOSED only — not selected. Behavioral/NAV change requiring (1) operator design direction (sub-target A vs B) and (2) a clean same-arm baseline post measurement-fix validation. Establishment is high-variance across emergent missions, so any validation needs >=2 same-arm runs to read signal over noise. Do not implement inside the autonomous loop without escalation.
